$schema: env-manifest v1 - see docs/deploy/ (never-again decision package item 2)
_purpose: Declares which env var NAMES must exist, must NOT exist, or are optional per Vercel environment. Values are never inspected here (Vercel CLI 'env ls' only reports names + environments, never values) - this catches a var being MISSING entirely, not a var holding a garbage/placeholder value. Seeded 2026-07-25 from a live `vercel env ls production` / `vercel env ls preview` read against the real sharpenly/inventory Vercel project.

preview._forbidden_reason: Preview is authenticated only through the dedicated smart-inventory-preview Firebase project. The browser configuration, explicit project ID, and Base64 Preview-scoped Admin credential are required. Emulator mode, production-mode opt-in, raw service-account JSON, and platform-owner overrides are forbidden so Preview cannot silently select a local or production backend. This name-only gate cannot prove values; runtime proof must confirm NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID is smart-inventory-preview before account or scan testing.
preview._required_client_firebase_vars_decision: Owner decision 2026-07-27: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE and the 7 NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* client vars are DELIBERATELY required (not forbidden) in Preview for preview auth testing against the dedicated smart-inventory-preview Firebase project (see FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID above). This is intentional and distinct from Production, which is untouched by this decision.
